body:
Support a bounded, explicit singleton GitHub keep-open research/artifact PR route. This is the provider dependency for VRPCadCore #143: its accepted research run must publish via PR while the source-geometry issue stays OPEN. The present provider has no conforming route.

## Authority and scope

Yanlei's 2026-10-02 ~17:27 standing delegation assigns held project judgments to the Codex decision shared Astra seat, followed by Host engineering execution. The bounded #143 decision (Astra memo SHA-256 3eedcc40d7568d4a9bfa95a5890e1e5b28e687abf54ad812cc1cf0a28213747a; Host adoption 4aeedbcf2d0e8cbba4eefcaa3a82355cb91c1220a7ea038efd1d82417fcdad50) explicitly approves this instrumental provider capability and supported scoped local adoption. The memo is retained under the consuming project's kaola-workflow/issue-143/.cache/host-astra-standing-closeout-decision.md. It grants no provider public release, blanket install or unrelated rewrite.

Historical #1098 D4=(a), keep-open merge-sink-only, remains accurate history and the default legacy refusal. This new delegated decision authorizes a bounded explicit GitHub singleton mode for this research publication need; retain default behavior and unsupported-forge/bundle refusals. Document the scoped evolution rather than editing historical decisions. No issue omission, fake claim, manual PR workaround, automatic merge or filler implementation to bypass the artifact PR rule.

## Measured

At provider fe7e4443a8c367cfc111c65755191ae6790e810e (12.4.0), independently read/hash-matched canonical and installed claim, sink-pr, sink-merge and closure-contract scripts:
- sink-pr.js:310–324 rejects issue_action: comment_keep_open in live/archive state before OFFLINE handling. Creation/reuse requires auto-closing references.
- finalize.skeleton.md only permits the merge sink for keep-open. Current claim/archive support can retain intent, but PR watchers assume remote members CLOSED and can misreport an intentionally OPEN issue.
- sink-pr's pr_auto_merge path may insert into a merge queue or auto-merge; this task requires a supported request-only guarantee even if that configuration is true.
- VRPCadCore #143 has a legitimate live singleton claim, immutable done ledger and accepted docs/CPU evidence. No archive or PR is yet published. This issue does not claim provider implementation or GPU evidence.

## Acceptance

Carry explicit durable intent through supported finalize preflight/archive/resume, PR create/reuse, request identity/push retry, live/archive watchers and closure audit/invariants. Preserve claim repository/digest/member/branch/MAIN/linked-worktree identities and ledger/evidence bytes. Support the bounded singleton; explicitly reject unsupported bundles and mixed dispositions.

Keep issue linkage without any auto-closing content or forge linkage, including qualified references and commit-message hazards. Do not adopt a close-mode PR; validate issue/base/head/action before unsafe effects. No automatic merge/queue even with global config true. Report created/reused request separately from mainline publication; actual OPEN after verified merge is intentionally kept-open, actual CLOSED a violation, unavailable probe unknown. No automatic reopen or manual close.

Independent test custody covers live/archive singleton success; linked-worktree MAIN resolution; immutable ledger/full evidence custody; malformed/conflicting/missing intent and unsupported bundle refusals; unchanged normal close-mode and merge artifact predicate; safe create/reuse linkage and request-only override; wrong-base/head, closed-unmerged and unknown probe paths; OPEN reuse/MERGED no-republish; crash/retry at archive/create/record/push without duplicate request or main/index mutation; both watcher lanes; unrelated run preservation. Reuse sound existing coverage and add only missing discrimination.

Author canonical scripts/helpers and templates/routing sources, regenerate required mirrors through provider tools, preserve other forge restrictions. Dock README/API/Unreleased/design/public-interface documentation. Run required focused generation/script-sync tests, walkthrough and applicable full unwaived chains. No public release. Supported scoped local adoption is separate after Host acceptance; verify exact consumer-resolved caller/sink/watcher paths and versions against the real #143 state shape without destructive dry-run or mixed installs.

searched: gh api open issues (all returned zero); gh issue list --state all --search "keep open PR" --limit 100 returned 30 historical CLOSED hits, including #1098/#1094/#517. No matching OPEN issue exists.
title: GitHub singleton keep-open artifact PR: supported request-only publication and truthful reconciliation
